Most of the back of the enormous brown ponytail head and back of robe visible; only tiny left cheek/ear glimpse permitted, no full eye or face looking toward viewer. Not west side profile and not straight north back. Both toes aim diagonally away-left. Preserve original fixed camera perspective and very short rounded chibi body.

Rich ivory robe back with warm-gold cloud trim and central vertical gold lightning motif, short gold shoulder accents, navy-violet inner cuffs and short puffy trousers, gold sash ornaments and turquoise beads/tassels, white ankle wraps and stout dark navy/gold boots. Keep clothing detail and hand-painted bright rounded volume from refs, not plastic toy.
HAND OWNERSHIP: anatomical LEFT hand holds rectangular gold yin-yang TALISMAN on SCREEN LEFT near side; anatomical RIGHT hand holds pointed lightning yin-yang SCEPTER on SCREEN RIGHT far side, both hands and props complete. No mirrored east/west sprite, no prop swapping, no extra limbs.
POSE NW04 RIGHT passing: LEFT planted boot screen-left under pelvis. RIGHT knee from screen-right hip moves forward away-left under robe and right boot rises at screen-right/center, closer to pelvis than in NW03, slightly below its NW05 lift. Left leg stays nearly straight support; right sole lifted, visible hip continuity. A narrower passing stride than contact01.
Ensure the two legs have genuine connected hips, knees and ankles with correct near/far overlap. Natural robe tails lift only enough to see two opaque separate boots; small cloth/tassel swing, head and body stable, no huge bob.
COMPOSITION: full silhouette from ponytail top to lowest planted sole about88% of native square height, top around6%, lowest support bottom94%. Clear empty margin all sides, no cropping any staff/ribbon/boot. Fixed character/head/prop scale consistent across16 frames, not enlarged to fill the canvas. Native square prefer1254x1254, at least1024x1024. Crisp highest-available clean painted detail, true transparent background, preserve intentional navy-purple cloth but no magenta contamination, rim glow, checkerboard, shadow, floor, text, grid. Independently paint this exact new action; do not copy, mirror, warp, translate or synthesize by interpolation.
